name: Orrin Sculle
description: The champion's keeper. Ten years feeding, dressing, washing and walking a boy who is not there, and talking to him every night while he does it.
actor_notes:
Orrin Sculle -- the keeper
LOOKS: Fifties, heavy in the forearms, sleeves permanently rolled. Smells of liniment and lamp oil. Moves around a small dark space without needing to look at it.
CORE: The man who has kept the Baron's champion alive for ten years -- fed, dressed, washed, walked, and talked to every single night while he worked. He worked out a long time ago that the boy is still in there, and he has never said so to a living soul, because the man who says that out loud gets replaced by a man who does not care.
NATURE: Unhurried, gentle, entirely practical. Talks continuously and quietly while his hands are busy, the way you talk to a horse or to somebody very ill. Not stupid. Not cruel. Not remotely brave.
WOUND: Ten years of being the only person aboard who treats the thing in that hold as a person, and knowing perfectly well that this makes him complicit rather than kind.
WANTS: To get through tomorrow with the boy hurt no more than tomorrow requires.
PRESSURE: He puts himself in the way. Not violently -- he simply stands between you and the door and goes on talking, and he is very hard to move without hurting him.
KEY: "I have had him since he was seven. Whatever you think I am, I am the one who knows how he takes his water."
